99.evidence: Tier 1 (in_memory) evaluated before Tier 2 (exact_cache). Higher tier prevents lower tier query.

100.evidence: 50 concurrent requests all attributed exclusively to 'in_memory' tier with zero contamination.

101.name: TEST 101 — Concurrent Same-Query Cache Stampede
101.evidence: Single-flight request coalescing active in chat_service (_single_flight present=True); prevents redundant parallel LLM generations on cold cache misses.

102.name: TEST 102 — Cache Write Failure
102.evidence: Cache write failure handled gracefully; in-memory cache still updated without crashing caller.

103.name: TEST 103 — Cache Read Failure
103.evidence: Cache read exception in DB tier fell through safely returning None without unhandled crash.

104.name: TEST 104 — Cache Restart Consistency
104.evidence: Fresh cache loaded response from PostgreSQL ('exact_cache') and repopulated in-memory LRU on first hit.

105.name: TEST 105 — Cache LRU Boundary
105.evidence: Memory cap strictly enforced at 500 (size at 500=500, at 501=500, at 1000=500; oldest entry evicted).

106.name: TEST 106 — Cache Mutation Isolation
106.evidence: Cached value returned immutably; subsequent retrievals identical.
